title: 1816 German Hot Chocolate
summary: Rich, custardy hot chocolate thickened with egg yolks, topped with whipped cream and shaved chocolate.
difficulty_reason: Tempering egg yolks into hot chocolate without scrambling takes care.
steps: Chop the chocolate finely and melt it in a saucepan over low heat.
Whisk in the milk, cream, sugar and cinnamon and heat until steaming; do not boil.
Whisk the egg yolks in a bowl, then slowly whisk in a ladle of the hot chocolate to temper them.
Pour the yolk mixture back into the pot and cook gently, whisking, until slightly thickened.
Stir in the vanilla and pour into cups.
Top with whipped cream and shaved chocolate.
